# P0.2 Copilot Customization Activation Map

**Tracking issue:** #332  
**Purpose:** make Copilot/VS Code customization discovery deterministic while preserving intentionally created engineering guidance.

This change is an **activation and routing refactor**, not a policy-reduction exercise. Detailed historical/current guidance moved out of automatic discovery is preserved and explicitly routed from compact active entry points.

## Discovery contract

| Surface | Executable/discoverable location | Repository rule |
|---|---|---|
| Repository-wide instructions | `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, root `AGENTS.md` | Keep global invariants/routing concise; detailed procedures belong behind scoped instructions, skills, prompts, or agents. |
| Path-specific instructions | `.github/instructions/**/*.instructions.md` | Files in the instruction discovery tree must be actual auto-applicable instructions with valid top-level YAML and a single `applyTo` value when scoped. |
| Prompt files | `.github/prompts/**/*.prompt.md` | The prompt discovery directory contains live reusable prompts only; analyses and backups belong in docs/archive locations. |
| Custom agents | `.github/agents/*.md` / `*.agent.md` | Every Markdown file in this directory must be an actual custom agent because VS Code discovers `.md` files there as agents. Documentation catalogs belong outside the directory. |
| Agent Skills | `.github/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md` | `SKILL.md` must start with valid YAML frontmatter. Large resources belong next to the skill and are referenced from the entry point for progressive loading. |

| `hardware-abstraction-device-impl.instructions.md` | `devices/intel_*_impl.c` | Device-specific implementation boundary, authoritative register sources, evidence-based capabilities. |
| `readme.instructions.md` | README filename variants | Full preserved README guidance: `.github/docs/README-INSTRUCTIONS-REFERENCE.md`. |
| `tests.instructions.md` | `tests/**` plus common `*.test.*` / `*.spec.*` patterns | Full preserved test instruction set: `.github/docs/TESTS-INSTRUCTIONS-REFERENCE.md`; current traceability contract remains authoritative. |

## Preserved guidance moved out of automatic instruction discovery

| Previous path | Current path / route | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `.github/instructions/Readme_instructions.md` | `.github/docs/README-INSTRUCTIONS-REFERENCE.md` + `readme.instructions.md` router | Original filename was not an auto-discovered instruction; full content is preserved without making the large document the automatic payload. |
| `.github/instructions/hardware_abstraction_SRC.md` | `.github/docs/HARDWARE-ABSTRACTION-SRC-REFERENCE.md` + HAL router | Preserve complete HAL policy while activating a compact mandatory boundary for `src/**`. |
| `.github/instructions/hardware_abstraction_device_impl.md` | `hardware-abstraction-device-impl.instructions.md` | Intended instruction now has a discoverable filename, precise scope, and executable content. |
| `.github/instructions/TESTING-LIFECYCLE-INTEGRATION.md` | `.github/skills/testing-lifecycle-guidance/reference.md` | Cross-phase methodology is on-demand guidance, not a global path instruction. |
| `.github/instructions/copilot-instructions.md` | `.github/docs/legacy/COPILOT-CODING-INSTRUCTIONS-LEGACY.md` | Preserve legacy evidence while preventing a second pseudo-global policy source in the instruction discovery tree. |
| Previous large `submodules.instructions.md` body | `.github/skills/submodule-guidance/reference.md` | The previous `applyTo: "**"` created unrelated always-on context; current activation is limited to actual submodule surfaces. |
| Previous large `tests.instructions.md` body | `.github/docs/TESTS-INSTRUCTIONS-REFERENCE.md` | Keep detailed rules available while normalizing activation/frontmatter and current executable traceability rules. |

## Skills activation corrections

The previous `.github/skills/intelavbfilter-testing/SKILL.md` had its YAML metadata inside a literal Markdown code fence. That prevented normal top-level Agent Skills parsing.

P0.2 preserves the complete former skill at `.github/skills/intelavbfilter-testing/reference.md` and replaces `SKILL.md` with a valid compact entry point that routes to the preserved material and keeps the critical repository-specific test invariants visible.

New routed skills added by this change:

- `submodule-guidance`
- `testing-lifecycle-guidance`

Both use valid `SKILL.md` metadata and reference their detailed resources explicitly.

## Prompt and agent directory hygiene

- `.github/prompts/README-IMPROVEMENTS.md` was analysis/documentation, not an executable prompt; it is preserved under `.github/docs/legacy/`.
- `.prompt.md.old` backups were moved from `.github/prompts/` to `.github/docs/legacy/prompts/`.
- `.github/agents/README.md` was documentation and could be discovered by VS Code as an agent; it is preserved as legacy documentation.
- The current agent catalog is `.github/docs/AGENTS-CATALOG.md`, outside the discovery directory.
- Existing working agent profile filenames were not cosmetically renamed: current VS Code supports Markdown agent files in `.github/agents/`, while `.agent.md` remains the preferred explicit naming form.

## Precedence and preservation rules

1. Current executable contracts (repository-wide instructions, current issue templates, CI validators, accepted architecture/issues) override contradictory historical examples.
2. Moving detailed guidance to a referenced resource does **not** make that guidance optional when its router/skill applies.
3. GitHub Issues remain lifecycle SSOT for requirement/architecture/test state and relationships.
4. Do not delete or simplify a rule merely because it appears generic; first identify its intent and ensure equivalent routing/enforcement exists.
5. If two active sources genuinely conflict, surface the conflict and resolve the authoritative contract instead of silently choosing one.

## Verification checklist

- [x] `.github/instructions/` contains only actual `*.instructions.md` files.
- [x] Intended README and HAL instructions use discoverable filenames and scoped `applyTo` values.
- [x] SSOT instruction has one `applyTo` key and internally consistent canonical include guidance.
- [x] Test multi-pattern activation uses one `applyTo` value.
- [x] Submodule guidance no longer applies to `**`.
- [x] Full verbose guidance removed from automatic discovery is preserved in docs/skill resources.
- [x] `intelavbfilter-testing/SKILL.md` has valid top-level skill metadata.
- [x] `.github/prompts/` contains only live `.prompt.md` prompt files.
- [x] `.github/agents/` contains only actual custom agents.
- [x] Phase 01–09 instruction files remain unchanged.

The intended outcome is **deterministic activation + progressive disclosure + policy preservation**.
